notes.title: The Legend of Skye is now available! Are you ready for the challenge?
notes.content:
The game is available in the store in English, German, Spanish and French. It has 25 achievements and a guide for lost adventurers.

notes.title: The Legend of Skye will be in 4 languages.
notes.content:
Skye will speak English, German, French and Spanish!

We will announce the release date very soon!

notes.title: New demo of The Legend of Skye!
notes.content:
You can now play the new demo of The Legend of Skye!

What are you waiting for?

You will see many improvements compared to the previous demo released half a year ago.

notes.title: New trailer available!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=xInz_DoNbTk;full][/previewyoutube]

More details, new scenarios and new characters.

The Legend of Skye is a new humorous point & click graphic adventure inspired by classics like Monkey Island or Loom, made by Point & Pixel Adventures. In The Legend of Skye we will put ourselves in the shoes of a young druid who will be claimed by her tribe to carry out an important mission.

The launch is expected in 2024. Wishlist!

notes.title: The demo is no longer available
notes.content: The Legend of Skye demo will no longer be available for now. Thank you for having tried it during these months and for the feedback received. It will help us a lot to put out a great game. For more information follow us on our social networks!

notes.title: The Legend of Skye - Available DEMO
notes.content:
A small demo of the game's prologue is now available. A few things to keep in mind:

- The English translation of the demo will not be exactly the same as the one of the game.
- The full version of the game will also be in German.
- The soundtrack is also provisional.
- There is nothing definitive, even in the prologue. I am open to listen to all your opinions and to change things.
- I need your feedback to make Legend of Skye a great game!

notes.title: Participation in Steam's Next Fest
notes.content:
The Legend of Skye will be participating in Steam's Next Fest! It will take place from June 19 to 26.

There will be a demo available to test the first chapter of the game! The demo will be in English and Spanish.

See you.
